key_insight: Confinement-controlled synthesis produces highly n-phase-pure 2D lead bromide perovskite microcrystals, enabling band-edge tuning through controlled powder mixing.
engineering_relevance: Phase-pure powders offer a route to tailored optical absorption and photocurrent response, but solar-cell performance is not demonstrated.
method: Synthesize layered perovskite microcrystals using cesium and butylammonium A-cations.
Characterize structure, composition, absorption, and emission.
Press pure and mixed powders into pellets for spectral and dynamic photocurrent measurements.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports sharp absorption onsets, single narrow UV-blue emission peaks, X-ray diffraction and energy-dispersive spectroscopy characterization, and composition-dependent pellet photocurrent.
watch_item: Translation from pressed pellets to efficient solar-cell devices remains unproven in the abstract.
paper_title: Confinement Controlled Phase-Pure 2D Layered Perovskites for Band-Edge Engineering
